cues.text: You step onto the shore, where the roar of the waterfall
in the southwest corner of the mountain lake can still be heard.
Nature somehow looks much cleaner and more untouched
here than on the side where you first entered the lake -
you don't even know anymore how long ago that was!
Nevertheless, you slowly begin to like this world,
even though you don't really know where your parents
will think you are if you don't call home tonight.
But it doesn't take much imagination to figure out that this
has probably been your last "solo vacation" until you come of age...
